mapper.sql: sa.id, sa.assignment_id, sa.student_id, sa.submission_content, sa.submission_file_path, sa.submission_time, sa.status, sa.score, sa.teacher_comment, sa.graded_time, sa.graded_file_path
mapper.insert: insert into student_assignment (assignment_id, student_id, submission_content, submission_file_path, submission_time, status, score, teacher_comment, graded_time, graded_file_path) values (#{assignmentId}, #{studentId}, #{submissionContent}, #{submissionFilePath}, #{submissionTime}, #{status}, #{score}, #{teacherComment}, #{gradedTime}, #{gradedFilePath})
mapper.select: select , s.name as studentName, ai.title as assignmentTitle, c.name as courseName from student_assignment sa join student s on sa.student_id = s.id join assignment_info ai on sa.assignment_id = ai.id left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id where sa.id = #{id}

select , s.name as studentName, ai.title as assignmentTitle, c.name as courseName from student_assignment sa join student s on sa.student_id = s.id join assignment_info ai on sa.assignment_id = ai.id left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id where sa.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and sa.student_id = #{studentId}

select , s.name as studentName, ai.title as assignmentTitle, c.name as courseName from student_assignment sa join student s on sa.student_id = s.id join assignment_info ai on sa.assignment_id = ai.id left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id where sa.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} order by sa.submission_time desc

select , s.name as studentName, ai.title as assignmentTitle, c.name as courseName from student_assignment sa join student s on sa.student_id = s.id join assignment_info ai on sa.assignment_id = ai.id left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id where sa.student_id = #{studentId} order by ai.publish_time desc, sa.submission_time desc

select , s.name as studentName, ai.title as assignmentTitle, c.name as courseName from student_assignment sa join student s on sa.student_id = s.id join assignment_info ai on sa.assignment_id = ai.id left join course c on ai.course_id = c.id
and sa.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} and sa.student_id = #{studentId} and sa.status like concat('%', #{status}, '%')
order by sa.id desc
